RateLimitLimit.description: Request quota for the current route and subject window.

RateLimitRemaining.description: Requests remaining in the current route and subject window.

RateLimitReset.description: Seconds until the current rate-limit window resets.

RetryAfter.description: Seconds to wait before retrying after a 429 response.

plaintext_token.description: One-time reveal. Store securely; it is not shown again.

chat_id.description: Optional internal zenture chat correlation id. Requires model_response_id when supplied. For external evaluations, omit chat_id, turn_id, and model_response_id.

external_id.description: Optional caller-owned correlation id for external evaluations.

metadata.description: Optional bounded caller correlation metadata. Do not include prompts, answers, URLs, source content, tokens, or PII.

model_response_id.description: Optional internal zenture AI-answer response id. When supplied, the evaluation targets an existing owned zenture chat response. Required when chat_id or turn_id is supplied.

turn_id.description: Optional internal zenture chat turn correlation id. Requires model_response_id when supplied. For external evaluations, omit chat_id, turn_id, and model_response_id.

user_message.description: Required user message that the external or legacy chat answer responded to.

amount.description: Display credit amount charged for this completed call. Internal ledger subunits are not exposed.

next_cursor.description: Opaque cursor for the next page. Null means there is no further page.

results.description: One row per evaluated KPI, including model_id, kpi_key, value, and safe analysis when available.

sources.description: Per-model source verification results, including status, httpStatus, verdict, and safe URL fields when available.

zenture_kpi_details.description: Per-model KPI detail map keyed by KPI id.
